saw_lines: Sportswear is bought for fit and feel, so shoppers judge it by how it moves and sits on the body.
So the sale is won in the first line, where a shopper decides whether the fit is worth a look.
Your 21 of 30 ads open on the geheimer 35% sale line, so test three new openers: the Tech Fit Collection, a full One Line Collection look, and the hoodie fit.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 4 Nov 2026
points: 21 of your 30 ads open on the geheimer 35% sale line, so a shopper who scrolls past it sees nothing new. Test three new openers: the Tech Fit Collection, a full One Line Collection look, and the hoodie fit.
One exact copy runs in 21 of your 30 ads, so shoppers who saw it once get the same message again. Keep the body text, but give each ad its own opening line and image, so every version reads as new.
None of your 30 ads shows a proof number, so a new buyer has no reason to trust the shop before clicking. Collect one real figure, a review count or orders shipped, and open the next batch with it.

Your median ad runs 133 words, and the longest is also 133, so the product gets buried under sale copy. Cut each ad to two short lines plus the offer, and name the hoodie, pants or shorts in line one.
